selection: All regular-season occurrences; unique game IDs sorted by earliest source date then numeric ID. Repeated occurrences retained; their starter snapshot target is refused.
schedule_requests: One per calendar month, exact startDate/endDate, hydrate linescore; no 2025 requests
failure_policy: Retain failed receipts without retry. Resume only missing requests in the same immutable batch plan. Refuse changed bytes, identities, or plans.
source_features: Availability and pre-cutoff starter identity only; no complete-history admission, fitting, scoring, or evaluation
